source: Checklist Insider (base/chrome, section totals); Checklistcenter.com (Chrome Prospect Autographs); cross-checked vs Checklist Insider Sapphire page
note: 200-card Draft Picks base set (BD-1 to BD-200) with a matching 200-card Chrome Draft Picks set (BDC-, identical numbering/players), headlined by 2025 MLB Draft picks Eli Willits, Tyler Bremner, Kade Anderson and Seth Hernandez. Chrome Prospect Autographs (CPA-) run 102 cards; Topps bills the product as the first Bowman cards for most 2025 draftees, but the checklists do not mark 1st Bowman per card so no 'first' flags are set here. Parallels, RetroFractors (Sadaharu Oh, Lou Brock) and variation subsets are omitted. Release slipped from December 2025 to January 14, 2026.
